title: One number logged, one line switched over
body: The notebook logs a tower visit under a program number, hours before the page notes the backup line switched to the shift's frequency. The key ring holds a spare tagged for a different gate. A haircut receipt sits behind, exact change.
rival_reading: A field program could log its own tower visit under the same numbering before handing the line back for a shift change; a shared program number does not by itself show a warning was mishandled.
gloss: A tower visit logged under a program number precedes the backup line being switched to the shift's frequency.

title: The readings started before the roster did
body: The notebook logs steady field readings on the backup line, entered under a shift number the roster lists an hour later. The water bottle beside it is dated the week before, sealed. A peach cobbler recipe copied inside, ingredients only.
rival_reading: A response crew could start logging on the backup line before its own roster caught up during a changeover; early readings under a later shift number do not by themselves show a program was already active.
gloss: Field readings on a backup line are entered under a shift number the roster does not list until later.
